name: Return to Nature
body:
School transmutation (polymorph); Level druid 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area all technological objects or creatures within a 40-ft.-radius burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

All technological objects or creatures within this spell’s area change into living natural beings. Objects carried by creatures are affected as well. Artifacts cannot be transmuted.

Non-sentient objects or creatures are transmuted to plants of the same size; sentient technological objects or creatures become animals or humanoids, depending on their intelligence and the caster’s choice. Only miracle, wish, or similar magic can restore a transmuted technological object or creature to its previous state.
